prompt: What change does the woman suggest to make the moon look bigger?
promptZh: 女方建議怎麼做，才能讓月亮看起來更大？

options.whyZh: 往後移燈是男方提出的，女方明確請他別動燈。

options.zh: 改用售票台窗口用的紙幕。
options.whyZh: 窗口紙幕供售票台使用，沒說能改變月亮影子的大小。

options.text: Move the cutout nearer the lamp.
options.whyZh: 她請男方把剪影朝燈移近，並說這樣影子會變大。
建議只移動現有的剪影，沒有要加第二個。

explanationZh: 她請男方把剪影朝燈移近，並說這樣影子會變大。
evidence: Keep the lamp where it is and bring the cutout a little closer to it. / That will make the shadow bigger.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Keep the lamp where it is and bring the cutout a little closer to it.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: That will make the shadow bigger.

vocabulary.note: 此處指放在燈前投出影子的月亮剪影。
